title: From Reconstruction to Imputation: Test-Time Optimization for Missing Time-Series Channels
abstract: arXiv:2611.06612v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Complete sensor-channel failures create a difficult form of time-series missingness: local interpolation is unavailable, and deploying a separately trained imputer for every failure pattern may be impractical. We ask whether a sequence reconstructor trained without artificial mask augmentation and then frozen can be converted into an imputer at inference time. Our method treats the missing entries of each test window as optimization variables, clamps all observations, and backpropagates through the frozen model to minimize reconstruction error only on observed coordinates. The resulting observed-self-consistency objective requires neither artificial mask augmentation nor full-channel dropout during reconstructor training. We characterize when this refinement is informative through the cross-Jacobian from missing inputs to observed residuals, and use an optional temporal-smoothness prior when that coupling is weak. translated_title: 从重建到插补：针对时间序列缺失通道的测试时优化
translated_abstract: 完整的传感器通道失效会造成一种困难的时间序列缺失形式：局部插值方法不可用，而为每种失效模式单独部署一个训练好的插补器也可能不切实际。我们探讨这样一个问题：一个未经人工掩码增强训练、随后被冻结的序列重建器，能否在推理阶段被转换为插补器。我们的方法将每个测试窗口中的缺失条目视为优化变量，固定所有观测值，并通过冻结的模型进行反向传播，仅在观测坐标上最小化重建误差。由此得到的“观测自洽性”目标既不需要重建器训练时的人工掩码增强，也不需要全通道丢弃。我们通过从缺失输入到观测残差的交叉雅可比矩阵刻画了这种精调何时能够提供有效信息，并在该耦合较弱时引入可选的时间平滑先验。在五个真实世界……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种测试时优化方法，将冻结的序列重建器在推理时转化为插补器——把缺失条目作为优化变量、仅最小化观测坐标上的重建误差，从而无需人工掩码增强或全通道丢弃训练即可应对完整传感器通道失效导致的时间序列缺失。
